name: Paco Lastdate
props: small folded bark-paper-like booklet with simple dot marks
visual: tall wobbling droplet, wide uneven eyes, clenched interior two-tooth mouth
personality: Can schedule anything except an interruption.
biography: His HyperNorm calendar has a designated day for events that were not meant to happen.
note: FrizzleBob: The emergency has been postponed to a more auspicious box.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Bram Brightstone
props: small green polished bead and blunt cord drill
visual: wide uneven puddle-shaped base with upright face, narrow sideways eyes, sealed crooked lip
personality: Thinks every perfect stone is concealing a flaw.
biography: He polishes away all ambiguous reflections for the Men in Black, then saves the dust.
note: FrizzleBob: The dust is acquiring opinions.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Mara Frothwise
props: tall clay cacao cup with a thick swirled foam top and a small pouring lip
visual: round generous bean, one eye squeezed joyfully, open sideways laugh with uneven interior teeth
personality: Maintains morale one carefully guarded serving at a time.
biography: Hunky and Dory demand an approved welcome; Mara pours it from an unapproved height.
note: FrizzleBob: Hospitality has exceeded the recommended foam.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Tomas Straightedge
props: short stone square and compact basket of smooth limestone blocks
visual: squared squat blob, one huge offended eye and one heavy lid, tiny pursed pout
personality: Believes a crooked step can undermine public confidence.
biography: He gives each HyperNorm rebuilding a straighter edge and the same impossible plan.
note: FrizzleBob: The staircase has arrived at a philosophical objection.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Orrin Softbounce
props: one small heavy rubber ball held on a padded belt at belly
visual: lean curved ink splat, smug eyes aimed down, narrow closed grin
biography: The Men in Black use his demonstrations to distract residents from the exposed card.
note: FrizzleBob: He is leading on points. Nobody has agreed what points are.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Lina Threadagain
props: small folded patterned cloth and chunky wooden weaving shuttle
visual: broad teardrop, sleepy opposite-direction gaze, sagging closed mouth
personality: Can repair a social fabric but charges extra for certainty.
biography: Her HyperNorm wraps use an official repeating pattern; one thread quietly takes another route.
note: FrizzleBob: The exception is holding the cloth together.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.
